faqs.q: Do I need a consultation before booking?
faqs.a: Yes, every new client has a free consultation before their first full treatment session. The consultation takes about 20 minutes. We review your medical history, assess your skin, explain the treatment fully and usually perform a patch test on the same day. There's no pressure to book further treatments.

faqs.q: What is a patch test and why do I need one?
faqs.a: A patch test is a small trial pulse of laser on a discreet area to confirm your skin responds safely before a full treatment. It takes two minutes. We wait 24 to 48 hours for any delayed reaction before booking your first full session. This is standard safety practice for all reputable clinics.

faqs.q: How do I know if laser is right for me?
faqs.a: We'll tell you honestly at your free consultation. Factors include your skin type (Fitzpatrick I-VI), hair or pigment colour, health conditions, medications, recent sun exposure and pregnancy status. If laser isn't the best option, we'll suggest alternatives rather than push ahead.

We don't treat clients who are pregnant or breastfeeding, under 16 (under 18 for some treatments), on oral isotretinoin (Roaccutane) or within 6 months of finishing it, with recent sunburn or active tan, with uncontrolled diabetes or epilepsy, or with active skin infections on the treatment area. Full contraindications covered at consultation.

faqs.q: Is laser safe on dark skin?
faqs.a: Our medical-grade lasers are safe on most skin tones, including Fitzpatrick V and VI, when settings are tailored carefully. Our diode laser is designed for all skin types with correct training and settings.

Common side effects are mild and temporary: redness, warmth, slight swelling and occasionally small bumps that settle in a few hours. Rare effects include temporary pigmentation changes. Serious effects are extremely rare when treatment is delivered by a trained therapist with appropriate settings.

faqs.q: How much do laser treatments cost?
faqs.a: Prices start from £35 per session for small areas like the upper lip. Each treatment page lists its guide prices, and course packages of six sessions at 20 per cent off most treatments give the best value.

faqs.q: Can I bring someone with me?
faqs.a: Of course, especially to your consultation or first session if it helps you feel comfortable. During treatments, guests usually wait in our reception area.
